import re

def normalize(text):
    lines = text.split('\n')
    out = []
    for line in lines:
        s = line.lstrip()
        s = re.sub(r'^(#|>|//|--)\s?', '', s)
        out.append(s)
    joined = ' '.join(out)
    return re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', joined).strip()
